name: AGEHA ~EXTRAVAGANZA~
source:
After a bug handler captures her, Ageha wanders through the dim forest until Shirou takes her away. As tentacles rape her, she blanks out and wakes up in a cramped prison cell. 

"Hey, you awake?"

Shirou smiles at her with a cruel kind of smile.
There is no escape, and no one to ask for help.
The days of constant torture are about to begin...

Yet, a glimmer of hope lies in another prisoner—a bug handler girl who, like Ageha, was raped by insect-human hybrids in the forest before Shirou picked her up. She's destined to become another pitiful plaything, but...

"Of course I’ll escape. Just don’t get in my way," Shumi, the bug handler girl, replies, rejecting both Ageha’s and Shirou’s offers for help.

Can Ageha really break free from this prison?..

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyc_members_guest/ageha_guest/ageha_story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
一名昆虫处理员抓住了她后，阿吉哈在昏暗的森林中徘徊，直到士郎将她带走。当触手强奸她时，她陷入了一片空白，并在一间狭窄的牢房里醒来。

“喂，你醒了？”

士郎对她露出残忍的笑容。
无处可逃，也无人求助。
持续折磨的日子即将开始……

然而，另一名囚犯身上还藏着一线希望——一名昆虫处理者女孩，她和阿吉哈一样，在森林里被昆虫与人类的混血儿强奸，然后士郎才把她救起来。她注定会成为又一个可怜的玩物，但是……

“我当然会逃跑。只要别妨碍我就行。”虫子处理女孩秀美回答道，拒绝了扬羽和士郎的帮助请求。

Ageha真的能逃出这座监狱吗？

[翻译自[url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyc_members_guest/ageha_guest/ageha_story.html]官网[/url]]
